title: Monster Totem 512x
description: This resource pack changes the totem of undying texture to the White monster can.
body:
# White Monster Totem

Ever feel like the vanilla Totem of Undying lacks that raw energy? Swap out the default sprite for an iconic, sleek **White Monster Energy Can**. Pop a cold one right when you need it most to escape the jaws of death.

---

## ⚡ Features
* **Sleek Redesign:** Replaces the standard Totem of Undying item sprite with a highly recognizable white energy can.
* **Massive Compatibility:** Works seamlessly across almost every version of Minecraft, from modern **1.26.x** all the way back to the classic **1.8.x**.
* **Lightweight & Clean:** Purely visual change. No dependencies, no mods required—just drag, drop, and play.

---

## 🛠️ How to Install
1. Download the `.zip` file for your preferred Minecraft version.
2. Open Minecraft and navigate to **Options** > **Resource Packs** > **Open Pack Folder**.
3. Drop the downloaded `.zip` file into the folder.
4. Select the pack from the "Available" column to move it to "Selected," click **Done**, and enjoy!

> ⚠️ **Version Note:** If Minecraft gives you a warning saying the pack was made for an older or newer version of the game, don't worry! You can safely click "Yes" to load it anyway. Because this pack only alters a single item texture, it remains perfectly functional across the entire version range.

---

## 💬 Community & Feedback
If you run into any issues, have suggestions for alternative flavors, or just want to share your clutch survival clips, feel free to leave a comment or open an issue on the source page! 

*Gamer fuel for your second chance at life.*
